summary: New accounts receive $10 of free credits, or $20 when signing up with a company email; no card is required. One shared credit balance covers Search, Contents and DeepResearch. While free credits remain, the account can use every source on Valyu's standard plans; licensed sources outside the standard plans still need separate access. Free credits expire 12 months after signup. After that, pay-as-you-go top-ups start at $10 (1,600 credits per $10) and monthly plans unlock more sources. There are no overage charges: when the balance cannot cover a request, the API returns 402 Payment Required and does not run it.
claim_steps: Sign up for a new Valyu account; use a company email for the officially stated $20 grant instead of $10.
Use the free balance to try Search, Contents and DeepResearch across standard-plan sources; licensed sources outside the standard plans need separate access. No card is required.
Spend the free credits within 12 months of signup. When the balance runs out, requests return 402 until you top up ($10 minimum) or choose a plan.
